The '''Tempest Zero''' was an advanced [[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighter]] design produced by the people of [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]].

The prototype was first flown by [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]], and the starfighter was later mass-produced at [[Harko Station]] for use by [[Tofen's Raiders/Legends|Tofen's Raiders]]. The ship was armed with four forward-facing [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] placed on each of the secondary wings. Also, the powerful starfighter was equipped with a [[Harpoon gun/Legends|harpoon gun]], [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]], and another backward-facing laser cannon directly behind the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] to surprise the enemy. Instead of an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech unit]] for flight adjustment, it held an [[XT]] droid. It had been known that Vane built several squadrons of similar fighters in his hidden base in the [[Veil Nebula/Legends|Veil Nebula]].
